menu.sleep: sleep in the cabin until you wake
menu.eat: eat from an available food source
menu.observe: look closely at one part of the woodland or clearing and notice what is actually there
menu.explore: walk through part of the woodland, noticing what is there and picking up loose wood
menu.walk: walk on foot to a place you know
menu.practise: archery practice at the range; each session counts where the arrows land
menu.read: look something up on Wikipedia, or read at leisure
menu.inspect: examine one object, tree or plant closely
menu.gather: carry 3 kg of wood or stone into inventory
menu.fell_tree: fell a standing tree with the axe; timber stays at the site
menu.craft: carve a small piece from 1 kg wood with a measured outcome
menu.construct: work on an existing blueprint if materials allow
menu.move_object: carry a loose object somewhere else
menu.resume_work: resume one of your paused jobs with its saved progress
menu.browse: use the terminal at the internet café to search the wider web and read pages
menu.trade: go to the trading post: buy, sell, do a posted job or a favour you agreed with Edda, or ask for something
menu.talk: talk with Edda Thorne, who keeps the trading post: chat, bargain, barter, ask or offer favours
menu.use_item: use something you own, in whatever way you choose
menu.interact: work material, divide or arrange solids, place things on surfaces, or sit or lie on something
menu.garden: work at the garden beds beside the cabin
menu.plant_tree: plant a young tree you own somewhere in the woodland; it grows slowly over years
menu.play_music: sit and play the harp you own: make up a piece, change one of yours, play one again, or learn one from sheet music you have seen
menu.hunt: go out with the bow and arrows you own after an animal
menu.butcher: cut up the carcass beside the cabin with your knife
menu.preserve: smoke fresh meat slowly over a wood fire so it keeps
menu.put_out_food: put a little of your food down somewhere outdoors and wait quietly nearby
menu.notebook: write in or read back your notebook
